inside_destinations_note: 18 kept places sit in 7 proposed town destinations (17 placed plus the held Wiradjuri Walking Track); none in an existing destination
standalone_note: 15 stand alone today (4 of them held for a pin); the 5 national parks are proposed park destinations (the park is the place), so they are counted under new_destinations

stronger_left_out.name: Monte Cristo Homestead
stronger_left_out.reason: Resolved: Wikivoyage itself calls it "all marketing fluff", house unmaintained, exhibits dusty and parts closed; high Wikipedia views reflect the haunted-house reputation, not a visit worth recommending. Revisit if a tourism source lists current tours.

stronger_left_out.name: De Bortoli Winery
stronger_left_out.reason: Winery cellar door: an operator venue, not a standalone attraction.

stronger_left_out.name: Murray to the Mountains Rail Trail
stronger_left_out.reason: The trail runs from Wahgunyah (Victoria) to Bright; Corowa is only the cross-river start; a route mainly in Victoria. Pass to the Victoria run.

stronger_left_out.name: Museum of the Riverina
stronger_left_out.reason: Resolved: local-history museum with one counted source (Wikivoyage) and no distinct draw; benchmarks to a local museum. Revisit only with a second source.

stronger_left_out.name: Tocumwal Railway Station
stronger_left_out.reason: Closed to passengers; freight point with no public visitor facility.

stronger_left_out.name: Murray Downs Homestead

stronger_left_out.name: Willans Hill Miniature Railway

stronger_left_out.name: High Country Rail Trail
stronger_left_out.reason: Route lies mainly in Victoria (Wodonga to Shelley); only the start is in Albury; not a place in this region. Pass to the Victoria run.

stronger_left_out.name: Yanco Powerhouse Museum

stronger_left_out.name: Lake Hume

left_out_below_lowest: Kept spots with 0 views and 1 counted source are the floor; every candidate with views above 0 or a second counted source that was left out is listed under stronger_left_out with its reason.
benchmark: No NZ benchmark place lies in this region. Region checks: Monte Cristo Homestead (15,752 views) rejected on Wikivoyage's own "marketing fluff" verdict and closed parts; annual events (Deni Ute Muster, Tumbafest, Turning Wave, Snake Gully Cup, Australian Art Deco Festival), monthly or weekly markets and open-one-day railways rejected as not permanent; wineries, a gliding club and a cotton gin rejected as operators; civic or exterior-only buildings (Roxy Theatre, Albury Library Museum, heritage walks) rejected; High Country and Murray to the Mountains rail trails passed to Victoria. Quirky icons kept on the Ohakune Carrot precedent: Big Cod, Big Guitar, Biggest Football, Dog on the Tuckerbox; Coleambally Wineglass Water Tower stays review.
method_note: Scores from verdicts.json (English Wikipedia views, counted sources); final verdicts are the skeptic's where one exists.
